description:
Assemble a standalone, human-readable handoff document for a component — a spec sheet for a ticket or design review, not an agent instruction. Combines the same pattern contract, design-source, design-tokens, and states/variants facts as a11y_build_prompt, so the two can never disagree, but formatted to be read by a person: no MCP setup, no verify-chain imperatives.

Use this when a designer wants something to attach to a ticket or send to a developer directly, instead of (or alongside) a11y_build_prompt's agent-facing prompt.

Args: same shape as a11y_build_prompt's design/component fields (task, component, framework, platform, wcag_level, design_system_kind/ref/image_data_uri, design_tokens).

Returns: a single markdown document string. This is NOT a release verdict — it explicitly discloses which manual gates remain unverified.

component.description: Optional known pattern to inject its full contract. Available: button, text input, link, checkbox, radio, dialog, menu button, listbox, grid, tree view, tree grid, date picker, tabs, accordion, combobox, tooltip, design system.

design_system_image_data_uri.description: Optional inline screenshot as a data: URI (small files only). Only used when design_system_kind is 'screenshot'.

design_system_kind.description: Source of truth to conform to, if any. 'figma'/'xd'/'screenshot' are design-file sources — never rendered artifacts, so they can never satisfy the automated release gate on their own.

design_system_ref.description: Reference for the source (URL, pkg@version, repo@SHA, a Figma/Adobe XD file/frame link, or a screenshot file path/description). Required if design_system_kind is not 'none'.

design_tokens.description: Raw design tokens (CSS custom properties, a token JSON blob, or plain name:value pairs) to use verbatim instead of inventing new ones.

framework.description: Target framework for the generated code.

platform.description: Target platform — adds the relevant touch-target/zoom/screen-reader considerations.

task.description: What to build, e.g. "a searchable country picker". Optional if `component` is set.

wcag_level.description: WCAG 2.2 conformance level to build to.

name: a11y_build_handoff_spec
title: Build a designer-to-developer handoff spec
